title: A link in a team message shows a preview card

source.ref: Hub plan 2026-11-24 (project thread: Design a central project and messaging hub; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/BqySUVMoZYsPcR49SBRUqB)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-24: chat shows links as bare text; the only outside-page fetcher is the business importer. Fix: Frequency item links render a live card under the viewer's own access; outside links get a link_previews cache (title, image, fetched_at, kept 7 days) filled by a server fetcher that refuses private addresses.
